resources.name: amodb API
resources.description:
amodb is a paid API for movie and TV metadata. It is compatible with TMDB v3 and OMDb.

Existing TMDB clients work by changing the base URL to `https://api.amodb.dev/3`. Paths, query parameters and JSON shapes match the TMDB v3 read endpoints.

## Access

amodb is a paid API. Get a key at https://amodb.dev/pricing. A key is 32 lowercase hex characters.

- TMDB style routes: send `Authorization: Bearer KEY` or add `?api_key=KEY`.
- OMDb route: add `apikey=KEY`.
- Images and plans need no key.

## Rate limits

Plans differ only in requests per minute. Every plan gets all data. There is no free tier and no trial.

| Plan id | Requests per minute |
|---|---|
| lite | 20 |
| pro | 40 |
| proplus | 120 |

Every keyed response carries `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining` and `X-RateLimit-Reset` (seconds). A 429 adds `Retry-After`. Live plan names and prices come from `GET /plans`.

## Languages

`language` accepts TMDB tags such as `ru-RU` or `pt-BR`. Fourteen base languages are served: en, ru, uk, be, zh, pt, bg, he, cs, ro, fr, pl, it, es. Any other value falls back to en.

## Errors

TMDB style routes return `{"success": false, "status_code": N, "status_message": "..."}`. The OMDb route returns `{"Response": "False", "Error": "..."}`.

## Write methods

TMDB write methods (account, session, rating and list writes) are not offered. They return 405 with status_code 37.

## Images

`GET /3/configuration` returns `images.secure_base_url`, which is `https://img.amodb.dev/t/p/`. Append a size and a `file_path` to build an image URL.

## Extensions

amodb adds `moods`, `soundtracks`, `ratings`, `wikidata` and `showtimes`. Each has its own route and an `append_to_response` value. `/3/find/{external_id}` also accepts `tvdb_id`, `wikidata_id` and `kinopoisk_id`.

parameters.description: Length of the Plot field.

parameters.description: Page of search results. Used with s.

parameters.name: r
parameters.description: Response format. Only json is offered. xml returns 400.
